body_lead: In May 2025, Uttar Pradesh (UP) Chief Minister (CM), Yogi Adityanath with Ajay Banga, President of World Bank(WB), jointly launched two initiatives ‘UP AGREES (Uttar Pradesh Agriculture Growth and Rural Enterprise Ecosystem Strengthening)’ and ‘AI Pragya (Artificial Intelligence Programme for Resourcefulness, Awareness, Growth, and Youth Advancement)’ to promote agricultural innovation and digital transformation at a launch event in Lucknow, UP. - The UP-government initiatives with the WB’s assistance aims to move closer to its vision of becoming a USD 1 trillion economy.
